Priyanka (Partnerships): Quick flag: CloudPartner announced they're moving their reporting window from PST-day to UTC-day and will send amounts in GBP starting next Tuesday. Need to avoid double-billing and entitlement shifts. Thoughts?

Ollie - Partner Ops: What format change? Per-file currency or per-line? Also any change to aggregations?

Amira (CloudPartner): Per-file currency header=GBP. We'll still provide hourly aggregates but the hour boundaries are UTC. No per-line currency.

Sam - Billing: Proposed rules: 1) Persist raw_partner_currency and raw_amount_minor_units; 2) Store fx_rate_at_ingest; 3) Normalize assignment by event_timestamp -> UTC_day; 4) Apply "round half away from zero" on invoice lines only. Reconciliation window 72h for late corrections.

Diego (Eng): Implementation plan: add partner_currency, partner_amount_minor, fx_rate and source_day fields to ingest schema. Keep raw_event_timestamp for forensic. Add feature flag legacy_local_day for partners that need PST behavior. ETA PR: 48h.

Ollie - Partner Ops: We'll request a 7-day sandbox from CloudPartner with old vs new files and provide a test harness. Also need a mapping for entitlements so reserved capacity doesn't drop because events moved dates.

Priyanka (Partnerships): Action items assigned: Amira -> sandbox files, Diego -> schema+flag PR, Sam -> billing playbook update, Ollie -> entitlement mapping runbook. ingests-bot: monitor ingest_errors and currency_mismatch for 48h after cutover.

ingest-bot: scheduled: monitor CloudPartner schema change on 2026-08-03T00:00:00Z.

Priyanka (Partnerships): Thanks all 1: quick sync in 30m to confirm owners.
